A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''commander''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Xesh Squad]] was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] around [[3642 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Xesh Squad Commander appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
